about_the_game:
🥒 Pickle Panic! – A Jar Full of Chaos

  • Keep your balance, don’t crack the jar, don’t drop the pickle.
    In this physics-based co-op adventure, up to 4 pickles are trapped in a single fragile jar, trying to reach the goal without shattering their only ride.

🟢 Features:

  • 🫙 One Jar. One Goal. Don’t Break It.
    The jar is your lifeline. Every fall, every bump weakens it. Make one wrong move and it all shatters — no second chances here.

  • 🎮 1 to 4 Players – Solo or Local Co-Op
    Play alone or with up to 3 friends. — the more pickles, the more chaotic the journey.

  • 🎯 Physics-Based Mayhem
    Pickles don’t bump into each other, but their combined forces move the jar. Every tiny movement affects the whole system — teamwork is crucial!

  • 🔥 Jar Escape Moments (Suprise..)
    Sometimes you might pop out of the jar...

  • 💔 When the Jar Breaks, It's Over
    The jar has a limit. Take too many hits, and it’s game over. Fall with it, and you restart from scratch.

🎉 Why Play?

  • Pickle Panic! is pure, unscripted chaos designed for couch co-op fans and lovers of absurd fun.



    Every run is a laugh riot — especially if you're brave enough to try with four pickles.

  • Jump in the jar, hold your breath... and don’t. let. it. break.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i5-4440 or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 / AMD RX 460
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i5-9600K / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 / AMD RX 5600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

short_description: Pickles in a jar, chaos on the rise! Wiggle, wobble and scream with your friends as you try to survive inside one fragile jar. Break it? Start over. Good luck.
